source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. Inside a thousand-year-old tree whose roots are being gnawed away: ancient, reverent and a little sorrowful, the slow heartbeat of the old tree spirit, glowing moss and roots. A dungeon theme with gentle forward motion, a noble cello melody answered by the flute. Tempo 84 BPM, 6/8 time, key of D dorian. Instrumentation: harp and hammered dulcimer ostinato, solo cello and wooden flute, soft wordless choir pad (no words), frame drum heartbeat, low contrabass, glockenspiel glints. Form: dulcimer ostinato intro; cello theme; flute answer over the choir pad; a darker middle with the heartbeat drum and low strings; cello and flute together; back to the ostinato. Duration: 120 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
